name: Sentinel-Suite
statusNote: pro v1.0.0 is field-verified live on a real IBKR/TWS account; everything after v1.0.0 (iceberg hero, 25Δ skew interpolation, freshness chip, live absorption recording) is browser/unit-verified only. All suites green as of 2026-07-01: 233 Rust tests + 47 golden vectors, 19 parity + 30 honesty tests, 28 iceberg pytest cases.
oneLiner: A four-tool, strictly read-only trading-intelligence cockpit suite for ES/NQ futures — it observes, records, and reviews; nothing here trades.
stack: vanilla JS/HTML/CSS webview UI, no framework
local Ollama (deepseek-r1:8b default) for the analyst

components.name: pro/
components.desc: The cockpit: paced engine loop pulling live/sim/replay data through Engine::cycle and the absorption detector into a JSON snapshot the webview polls.

components.name: sentinel-core
components.desc: Canonical four-factor math (OBI, VWAP, CVD, ATR, skew, confluence), ported 1:1 from v3's Python; pinned by 47 golden vectors.

components.name: sentinel-ib
components.desc: Read-only IBKR/TWS live source — depth book, trade prints, options chain; no order method anywhere.

components.name: sentinel-absorption / sentinel-skew
components.desc: Book-vs-tape iceberg/absorption FSM and 0DTE put-call skew types.

components.name: sentinel-alerting / sentinel-report
components.desc: Outbound-only Discord webhook pump; tape replay into Markdown/HTML session reports.

components.name: stage2/
components.desc: Research tool turning a session tape into a 4-table evidence dataset, grade, and dashboard.

components.name: analyst/
components.desc: Feeds a session report to local Ollama for an EOD analyst-style review.

components.name: iceberg/
components.desc: Re-runs a Python port of the cockpit's absorption FSM over a tape for iceberg/absorption study.

dataFlow: The live source reads IBKR/TWS depth, trade prints, and the options-greeks chain (or a simulated/replay source).
Each cycle the engine computes OBI/VWAP/CVD/ATR/skew while the absorption FSM runs on the same inside quote and tape, stamped with feed-health diagnostics.
The engine publishes JSON snapshots into shared state; the webview polls about once a second and renders the cockpit.
Every live or sim cycle writes to a gzipped JSONL recording.
On demand, the report crate replays the tape into a session report JSON plus Markdown/HTML.
Downstream and offline: the tape feeds stage2 (evidence dataset + dashboard) and iceberg (iceberg study + HTML); the report JSON feeds the analyst via local Ollama.
decisions: Consolidate, don't rewrite — zero core-math rewrites in the merge of four repos.
Fold the standalone iceberg engine in, and fix its classify_sign one-sided-book bug that silently biased CVD.
Extend the golden vectors 45→47 to pin that fix as the acceptance bar.
Share the fixture file, not a shared Python core, to keep the two research engines independently editable.
Rebrand is presentation-only; crate, identifier, and schema names untouched.
Read-only enforcement is structural: no order method exists anywhere in the IB crate.
